image_description: A flat-lay photograph of four vintage comic books arranged in a grid. The top-left is 'Strange Tales' featuring a red alien creature; top-right is 'War Comics' with soldiers; bottom-left shows a green monster (likely Hulk or similar) fighting; bottom-right features a superhero character. The comics exhibit signs of age, including yellowing paper and wear on the edges. Text is visible on all covers but appears distorted and illegible due to AI generation artifacts.
